imported_definition.name: Adaptive Capability Composition & Assembly Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Assemble several existing capabilities into a mission-specific composite capability when no single capability can satisfy the requested work.

imported_definition.name: Mission Execution Graph Compiler & Dynamic Replanning Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Compile the selected capabilities into an executable mission graph and re-plan safely when context, availability, evidence or failures change during execution.

imported_definition.name: Multi-Engine Result Fusion & Conflict Resolution Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Fuse outputs from multiple engines/providers into one evidence-preserving result without hiding disagreement, uncertainty or minority evidence.

imported_definition.name: Capability Performance Memory & Selection Learning Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Learn from prior capability/provider executions so future selection and configuration improve for each mission and environment.

imported_definition.name: Dynamic Capability Loader & Runtime Attachment Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Load, attach, detach or temporarily activate an already approved capability at runtime so missions can use needed capabilities without rebuilding the whole platform.

imported_definition.name: Capability Gap Acquisition & Genesis Orchestrator
imported_definition.purpose: When a mission lacks a required capability, drive the search-acquire-compose-create cycle and return a verified candidate path without treating registration as authorization or production readiness.

imported_definition.name: Evidence Verification Corroboration & Contradiction Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Determine what acquired information is supported, contradicted, stale, weak or unresolved before it is promoted into intelligence or knowledge.

imported_definition.name: Research Synthesis & Knowledge Integration Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Synthesize verified evidence into mission-relevant knowledge without collapsing uncertainty, disagreement, provenance or open questions.

imported_definition.name: Hypothesis Falsification & Causal Reasoning Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Reason over competing explanations, actively seek disconfirming evidence and distinguish correlation from supported causal explanations.

imported_definition.name: Scenario Forecast & Uncertainty Intelligence Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Generate scenarios and forecasts with explicit assumptions, uncertainty and later reconciliation against actual outcomes.

imported_definition.name: Adaptive Latency & Performance Orchestration Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Continuously optimize mission execution for responsiveness, latency, throughput and resource efficiency by coordinating existing BONDS performance primitives without duplicating their runtimes.

imported_definition.name: Continuous Global Knowledge Observatory Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Continuously observe configured global knowledge domains and trigger targeted research when meaningful new information or change is detected.

imported_definition.name: Frontier Discovery & Emerging Capability Intelligence Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Discover emerging external methods, tools, models and capabilities and convert relevant advances into evidence-backed BONDS capability-gap candidates.

imported_definition.name: Comparative Capability Benchmark Observatory Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Continuously compare BONDS capabilities with relevant external capabilities using reproducible evidence and convert proven deficits into improvement candidates.

imported_definition.name: Research Mission Portfolio & Studies Center Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Coordinate BONDS studies and research missions from question definition through collection, evidence, synthesis, open questions and capability-improvement handoff.

imported_definition.name: Insight Proposal Opportunity & Goal Formation Engine
imported_definition.purpose: Convert verified information and synthesized insight into multiple alternatives, repeatedly analyze and compare them, filter weak proposals, and produce evidence-linked goal/opportunity candidates for internal improvement or external value creation.
